label: preserve-both-notes-resource-copies
added:
# A Python file can be both an imported module and a packaged source
        # resource. Preserve the existing identity key only when both actual
        # copies agree; a data copy cannot replace a missing/changed module.
        package_source = native_source.startswith("hepta/") and native_source.endswith(".py")
        if package_source and native_source not in entries:
            raise ValueError("installed source resource has no package module: " + native_source)
        resource_digest = sha256(_agent_resource_path(native_source).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if package_source and entries[native_source] != resource_digest:
            raise ValueError("installed package module and source resource differ: " + native_source)
        entries[native_source] = resource_digest

removed: - name: Preserve actual cold failure and stage evidence
added:
- name: Native source admission build and explicit public compiler
        run: |
          python -B - <<'PYSOURCEBUILD'
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames((
              'tests.test_hia_source_build',
              'tests.test_hia_program_selfhost',
              'tests.test_hia_source_release_integration',
              'tests.test_hia_source_admission_native',
          ))
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          passed = (result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped
                    and not result.expectedFailures and not result.unexpectedSuccesses)
          raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)
          PYSOURCEBUILD
        env:
          HEPTA_HIA_SOURCE_BUILD_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_SOURCE_BUILD_OBSERVATIONS: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-source-build
          HEPTA_HIA_SELFHOST_BUILD_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-selfhost-build
          HEPTA_HIA_SOURCE_ADMISSION_COLD_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-cold.json
          HEPTA_HIA_SOURCE_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-source-admission
      - name: Preserve actual cold failure and stage evidence
